description: Narrow grant for the drive-by download gate (v0.18.9): account, tabbed, and split-pane webviews may invoke ONLY note-user-gesture, which records a last-gesture timestamp and nothing else. It cannot read data, trigger actions, or exfiltrate anything. Remote pages get this one command because the gesture signal has to come from the page itself; the gate is a heuristic against drive-by downloads, not a sandbox — a page that knows the command name can fake a gesture.
